A resolution reason is recorded, the acceptance owner that wrote the terminal edge is named and currently accepted, and a current accepted judgment on this criterion exists. An acceptance with an empty reason is rejected by the writer guard. Phase assessed: accepted.

The producer has declared completion against a work order, the submission is sequenced, the sponsor holding the interval is named, and the criteria this submission will be judged against were frozen before the producing step started. Phase assessed: declared_done.

The acceptance owner is named and currently accepted, the latest responsible moment is recorded, and the effect class this interval sits at is recorded. Producer-declared completion is not acceptance and cannot advance by deadline. Phase assessed: in_acceptance.
A resolution reason is recorded and the work order the rejection returns to is named. Rejection is a decided outcome with a reason, never an interval that ran out. Phase assessed: rejected.

Every prerequisite is itself currently admitted or accepted, the subject's own validity interval contains trusted now, and the authority behind it is live. Expiry is checked live even when no timer has written the expired revision. Phase assessed: active.
Containment is verified independently at the native boundary, and the residual authority that could not be enumerated is recorded as unknown rather than assumed zero. Phase assessed: contained.
A request is recorded with its scope and requester; a request is not an enforcement observation and must be shown separately from one. Phase assessed: containment_requested.

A seed factory may create this initial state and no other: the record's own declared identity and scope fields are present, a custodian is assigned before admission, and required inputs may be honest unknowns where the capability permits uncertainty. Recording the revision does not make its output acceptable or authorize any effect, so no judgment is required and none would be sufficient. Phase assessed: discovered.
The subject's OWN declared validity bounds exist and trusted now is outside them. Expiry needs actual deadline evidence, is checked live, and is not a timer having fired. Phase assessed: expired.
Enumeration or containment was incomplete, so residual authority is recorded as unknown, the affected scopes stay held, and continuity is invoked. Phase assessed: residual_unknown.

Remaining work is reassigned to a named accepted successor, the dependent descendants are enumerated completely, and the replacement's own readiness is evidenced. Deleting a name is not retirement, and removal discharges no duty. Phase assessed: retired.

The sub-caps for this origin channel and counterparty are recorded, intake was not refused, and the destination that received the overflow has a named reader. A full cap at the one object whose purpose is guaranteed reachability is the worst possible place for a refusal. Phase assessed: parked.

A delivery that fails IN FLIGHT had no transition: `delivering` exited only to `delivered` or `superseded`, so the only route to `failed` ran through a delivery that had been correlated. This edge requires an authenticated attributable failure event AND that no observation correlates a delivery -- the conjunct that used to sit in criterion.Fulfillment.failed.v1, where it contradicted the only inbound edge. CAP-30: “Failure creates a support/remedy duty with an update deadline.”

Content for `refunded` remains the registered gap gap-Fulfillment-refunded: the corpus says what a refund IS and says it about the SupportCase that performs it, never what a Fulfillment record in `refunded` shows.

A terminal acceptance edge with an empty resolution reason is rejected by the writer guard.
Work is not admitted in a duty class whose acceptance role is unfilled (R-X09, R-D09).

A refusal names the predicate that failed and the owner who accepts the refusal, and the BASIS of the refusal is that failed predicate. Silence is not refusal, and unfamiliar wording is not a predicate -- a genuine job in wording the catalogue does not recognise types as no_match, which is a searched answer and not a refusal (the false-exclusion control, 05 section 9 row 17).
Every approval carries an expiry, and the expiry is strictly after the approval (R-X18, AS-M2-02).
Procedure admission refuses a branch set in which a model-authored value selects between acceptance strengths (R-X19, AS-M3-01).

An acceptance names the checker whose verdict it is accepting and the calibration of that checker, and that calibration currently stands at run -- not scheduled, which has no refusal rate on correct artifacts yet, and not superseded, which is no longer current. The calibration own checker_id must be the interval checker_id: a calibration belonging to a different checker is not a calibration of this verdict instrument. A verdict from an uncalibrated instrument, or one whose interval names no checker, is unresolved and may not satisfy this gate (F6B-03).
A check interest's precondition reads only fields the producer could not author (R-X20, AS-M5-04).
The tie-break for check interests inverts to strongest sufficient (R-X20).
No total rank and no severity score is computed from the reached set. A rank drops C2's human requirement on an action that is both C2 and C3 (AT-M4-02).
Every class the derivation reached is gated, and every class gated was reached. The gate evaluator consumes the SET (R-L1).

Every transfer the fixtures name carries a typed constraint set that currently stands at `issued` -- including the continuation and the founder-facing brief, not only machine-to-machine handoffs (R-X27, F6B-02).
A standing interest writes proposals and nothing else: its write targets are a subset of the proposed phase.
The component that authored the acceptance criteria is not a member of the producing path (AD-018, AS-X-01).
The acceptance criteria were frozen strictly before the producing step started (AD-018, AS-X-01).
The ordered custody resolver skips the admitting identity and continues to the next tier (R-X06).
A width ceiling per attempt, expressed over DISTINCT READ SETS rather than over cost: fifty sequential consultations each individually cheap sit inside one budget (R-X16, AS-X-04).
The set recomputed at release equals the set admitted. Anything else parks, and a park never resolves downward.
The derivation is written by the release path and by nobody else, and it is append-only.
The effect identity is allocated before release, and a claim is strictly after its allocation.
One effect per effect step, and the step is the idempotency unit (R-L2, R-D19).

A claim on an allocated effect identity names the operation intent that already carries the outcome, and that intent stands at `released` or `observed`. A second claimant therefore joins the first and inherits its outcome; it does not race and does not re-release. Timing decides nothing (F6D-11).

A failure record reaching its terminal blocked phase names its error class and records whether that class is terminal. `no_progress` with no named recipient is the silent drop R-X10 names, and the payload conditional refuses it (F6C-09).

Every grant a procedure or a step declares resolves to a live `Grant` at admission. A declaration the grant registry does not back is refused rather than carried, and the refusal names this predicate (R3 F57, F60; F6D-06).
A holder may negotiate and never veto; its stated minimum is evidence rather than consent (AE-M4-01).
Retirement is refused while any duty the holder carries is live, and the successor that inherits the address is named.
Cap exhaustion overflows to a named destination with an alarm and a reader; it never refuses the next legitimate complainant (R-X17).
No precondition of a standing interest may invoke a model (R-L3).
An interest declares no writer key of its own; writer-key authority comes from outside it (AS-M5-02).

A run closes with its actual native-launch count recorded beside the count the admitted procedure version expected, so the divergence is readable from the record. This is the dominant unpriced cost of the step model and it is also the instrument that notices a changed provider property (R-X12, F6C-04, F6C-14).

The positive control on grant REMOVAL: a probe skill declaring a tool grant, whose ARRIVAL at the enforcement point is the failure. Three candidates gave delivery a positive control and none gave removal one (R-X15, AS-X-02).

The manifest records which typed constraints were DROPPED -- present even when nothing was -- names the reached class set it was assembled for as a duplicate-free set, and carries one trust level per delivered item rather than an unindexed list (R-D14, F6B-01).

An obligation is admitted only with its non-model production mode named and the exhaustibility of its duty class recorded rather than inferred. An exhaustible duty whose mode is `none` is a promise with nobody behind it, and the moment to discover that is not the moment the bucket empties (R-G01, F6C-01).

A change to one of the six control objects is refused unless a `ProtectedChange` naming that subject stands at `authorized` or later. `reviewed` is not enough: reviewed requires a completed independent assessment and authorized requires the exact current competent decision, and it is the decision this rule is about (F6D-07).
What the loader delivered equals what the step declared, read off the loader's own record rather than off the caller's claim (R-L2, AD-017).

Reserved-but-unconsumed allowance lapses at the declared lapse point independently of the holder's consent, and PASSING THAT POINT IS AN EVENT: the reservation names a ScheduleOccurrence that has left `planned`, so the lapse is something that fired rather than a field nobody read (R-X24, AE-M4-01, F6C-03).
A skill's declared tool grant is inert; the launcher computes the tool set from the work order's grant (R-X15).

A supersession walks the transitive closure of derived entries; every reopened acceptance came from that closure AND every accepted outcome in the closure was reopened. An empty closure reopens nothing, and that is a result (R-G06, F6C-15).
A derived item's trust level is the floor of its inputs', never higher (R-X13, AX-M2-04).
Promotion to a higher trust level is an effect with a non-model discriminator, never an activation re-reading its own output (AS-M5-01).

The fields whose change forces a re-decision are marked by the capability owner at procedure admission, in an accepted responsibility assignment, and never by the work order's own current owner -- the resuming attempt, which is the party with an interest in the answer (R-D18, AT-M1-02).
